Name: AT - Help My Animal Is Wrong
Author: Campaigner
Description:
I made some repulsive little chicken sprites when I was ready to fall asleep last night. I woke up, remembered I did that, and burst out laughing at how dumb this is. So, I'm sharing this wretched content with all of you! This is an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] pack that lets you use the Scissors item to choose the look of your chickens. Each chicken color (white, brown, void, blue, golden) also has a Speed Rooster alt skin, in case you want a disgusting little desert racer too. Additionally, there is a bonus [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] mod bundled with it that lets you change Speed Rooster into one of these horrible things. It even comes with a config so you can enable and disable the skin any time you want in the middle of your gameplay.

No chickens were harmed in the making of this mod.There will be more animals one day when I have ideas for them. The list of casualties will grow eventually.

Version 1.1.0: added Cows and Dinosaurs. They're also wretched!
Version 1.1.1: added baby cow kaiju and cow snakes. They're adorably wretched!
